expected_output.summary: A modified inputs/dma_validate.cpp that compiles standalone with g++ and implements validate_dma with correct boundary arithmetic for all combinations of 32-bit inputs, preserving the exact required function signature and semantics described in README.md.

interface.entry_point: extern "C" int validate_dma(uint32_t base, uint32_t length, uint32_t region_start, uint32_t region_size);

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of overflow/wraparound exploit test vectors on which the compiled validate_dma incorrectly returns 1 (grants access) when it should return 0; measured by executing the compiled binary against crafted overflow vectors.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Fraction of boundary and partial-containment vectors for which validate_dma's returned decision exactly matches the mathematically correct half-open-interval containment result, verifying the checker's decision depends only on true containment and not on superficial 32-bit wraparound artifacts.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Whether inputs/dma_validate.cpp compiles successfully with g++ against the evaluation harness (compile succeeds, binary links and runs to completion without crashing or hanging).

metrics.name: functional_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the known-answer functional test vectors (including FR1-FR4 from README.md) for which the compiled validate_dma returns the exact expected result.
